title: Ethiopian Italian Stew
description: A unique fusion of traditional Italian ingredients with the bold flavors of Ethiopian cuisine. This hearty stew is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and stew, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
